summary: Changes the PIM Sparse Mode Join message format so a node can attach extra attributes when it joins a multicast tree. Before this there was no way to pass such additional information. This is a Proposed Standard, updated by RFC 7887.

eli5.summary: When you sign up for a newsletter, you may want to add notes like how you want it delivered. This lets a router add extra notes when it asks to join a multicast group.

questions: what is the pim join attribute format
how to add attributes to a pim join message
